icon.$description: Iconography foundation. Reference metadata for the SVG icon set in assets/icons, plus the size scale used to render it.

intrinsic.$description: Attributes shared by all 1630 SVG files (815 icons x 2 variants). Verified across the full set.

padding.$description: Fixed 10x10 canvas. Every icon shares the same viewBox, so optical size and alignment stay consistent across the set. Use this as the default.
padding.usage: Default. Buttons, nav bars, lists, inline text - anywhere icons sit in a grid or next to each other.

no-padding.$description: viewBox is trimmed to each icon's own bounding box (470 distinct viewBoxes). The glyph fills the frame edge to edge, so rendered size varies per icon.
no-padding.usage: Only when the icon must fill its container exactly - hero art, spot illustration, custom-cropped composition. Do not mix with the padding variant in the same row.

naming.variantSuffix: -02, -03 mark alternate cuts of the same concept (arrow-down, arrow-down-02, arrow-down-03)

coloring.$description: Icons carry fill="currentColor", so they inherit the CSS color of their parent. Set color with a color token rather than overriding fill.

size.$description: Rendered icon sizes. Aligned to the 4px spacing rhythm.

md.$description: Default. Matches the intrinsic 24px width/height of the source SVGs.
